full_page.content:
1936, March
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 97 Cont.
Mar. 10 Violet Tourangeau - 18 - operation for append. Jan. Ist. Came home still in pain. Now trouble seems to have gone to kidney-condition and is fearful.
10 Eva Profenius - 59 - Asthma, Heart, Kidney, High-blood-pressure, etc. Enrolled To-day (50) promising Perpt. if ...
Lillian Spaziano - 25 - intestinal-trouble .... doctring for 4 yrs. Drs. baffeled -- Enrolled again To-day and promises frequent Commun- ion.
Mrs. Mary Montreuil - 50 - inward-cancer - husband & four children
Rollin M. Hyde - 59 - non Cath. has Wife and 8 children - sarcomic cancer on tongue since November. Suffers fearfully. Fears.
Page 98
Mar. 10 Mrs. Clara Waire - 44 - Spinal troub. fearful ... Drs. quite at sea - can't help.
Frank Lasuita - 12 - blind in one eye
Lorraine Gowenlock - 21 - double cataracts .....
Charlott Barnes - no-Cath. Educated in Monroe Convent ...
Also Dorothy West - 18 ... .. child ..
Mary O'Grady - Cured! ! !
Page 99 Mar. 11 Sister Hugoline ... in goiter operation - operated on ... low Mayme Gilreath - 46 - cancer
Castancia -??? "Spiritia-Catholic" (Cor. Baldwin & Gothe) . causing neighbor fearful trouble .... Son not to confession in three yrs.
Doublas Kemp - 23 - taks ... fits ... non-Cath. (Presbiterian)
14 Helen Gassen - 28 - husband and little girl to care for. June 19th last fell 22 storys on pavement .. both legs broken-compound fracture concussion of brain, etc. etc. given up by all. Mother and husband came and inrolled .... here To-day looking fine first time out To-day still on crutches.
